Game Overview

In Squirrels and Acorn - Draw your level!, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your creativity in Squirrels and Acorn, where you sketch unique platformer levels and race to the acorn. Design thrilling paths, outwit traps, and maneuver your customizable squirrel across diverse maps. Quick reflexes and strategic thinking pave your way to victory in this charming two-player adventure.
